name: rule-3
label: R3 · MEDIA-TYPES
title: Spend the effort on media types
summary: In brief: describe media types and relations, not which methods go to which URIs. This is what HEART's spec is.
quote: “A REST API should spend almost all of its descriptive effort in defining the media type(s) used for representing resources and driving application state, or in defining extended relation names and/or hypertext-enabled mark-up for existing standard media types. Any effort spent describing what methods to use on what URIs of interest should be entirely defined within the scope of the processing rules for a media type (and, in most cases, already defined by existing media types). [Failure here implies that out-of-band information is driving interaction instead of hypertext.]”
cite: Roy T. Fielding, “REST APIs must be hypertext-driven”
